_about: Announced lineups and retirements that FIBA's own pages do not show yet. A FIBA-posted roster for a game always wins over this file. 'from'/'to' are the dates (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) the lineup applies to. For a player new to our data, add pos (G, F or C) and, if known, min (expected minutes) so his estimate starts from the right role; without min he starts at 12 minutes.

lineups.event: FIBA World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers, November window
lineups.source: Gilas Pilipinas 12-man lineup announced by SBP (GMA News graphic, courtesy FIBA/SBP), supplied by the site owner on 2026-11-11
